Result of the Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed Companies conducted by Thai Institute of Directors (IOD)

The Company was one of 55 companies that received the result of the 2015 corporate governance assessment in the “Excellent” level and was categorized in the 5-star group (assessment scores of 90%-100%) out of 588 listed companies that were assessed for corporate governance. This is the fourth consecutive year that the Company was ranked in the 5-star group since 2012, which is an affirmation that the Company has stood by its principles of good corporate governance for the sustainable development of the organisation.

Result of the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders Quality Assessment conducted by Thai Investors Association (TIA)

This assessment aims to evaluate the quality of the annual general meeting of shareholders held by listed companies based on what listed companies should do before the meeting, on the day of the meeting, and after the meeting. Because the Company has given importance and has striven to improve the quality of the Company’s annual general meeting of shareholders continuously and regularly, the Company received a perfect 100 scores for the quality of the 2015 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, which was the third consecutive year since 2013.

Listed Companies with Outstanding Achievement in Business Sustainability (ESG100) assessed by the ESG Rating Unit of the Thaipat Institute
The Company was ranked as one of the top 100 listed companies that have demonstrated outstanding environmental, social and governance (ESG) achievement in the year 2015, out of 567 listed companies. This showcases the Company’s focus on and responsibility for the environment, society and governance to create sustainable development.
2015 Sustainability Reporting Awards organised by the Office the Securities and Exchange Commission, Thai Listed Companies Association, CSR Club, and Thaipat Institute
The Company was awarded the “Recognition Awards” for the 2015 Sustainability Reporting Awards, out of a total of 106 companies that submitted their sustainability report for the consideration. This shows that the Company has placed importance to the disclosure of both financial and non-financial information to the investors and other stakeholders of the Company which would create sustainable development for the organisation in the long run.
BTS Group is awarded the Sustainability Report Award 2015

Mr. Rangsin Kritalug (Right) Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer, BTS Group Holdings Plc was handed over the Sustainability Report Award 2015 in the ‘Recognition’ category by Mr. Chaiwat Uthaiwan (Left), Vice Chairman of Thai Listed Companies Association in the Award Presentation Ceremony of the Sustainability Report Award 2015, organised by CSR Club, Thai Listed Companies Association on 15th December 2015 at the Exhibition Hall, the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Rama 4 Road.

In 2015, there were a total of 106 listed companies participating in this competition, and BTS Group was one of 32 companies nominated by the committee. The Sustainability Report Award 2015 is divided into 4 categories, consisting of The Excellence Report Award, The Best Report Award, The Outstanding Report Award and The Recognition Report Award.
